calls.prompt:
Create ONE 2D fighting-game CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of Quill (the Storyteller), an ORIGINAL character for an original
indie fighting game. It must NOT resemble any existing anime, manga, game or film character.

The FIRST attached image is the approved HOUSE STYLE (another character of this game): copy its rendering exactly - the same
premium high-detail anime fighting-game sprite style, line work, cel shading, metal highlights, proportions, scale and the
same kind of sheet layout - but draw Quill, NOT the character shown there. The SECOND attached image is Quill's portrait:
match the face, hair, colours and costume from it.

THE CHARACTER:
A big, warm, jovial storyteller in his thirties with a broad roguish grin, laughing hazel eyes and a neat short ginger beard. Hair: a wild mane of tight GINGER-ORANGE curls, voluminous and pushed back off the forehead, falling to the shoulders. Broad shoulders and a relaxed, sturdy build. Costume: a loose WHITE linen shirt with full sleeves rolled to the elbow and an open collar; a dark BROWN leather waistcoat with brass buttons and a gold watch chain across the chest; charcoal slacks tucked into tall brown leather boots with brass buckles. WEAPON: a giant QUILL PEN used as a staff, about as tall as his head and shoulders: a pale ivory shaft with gold bands and a dark ink-black nib at its base, topped by a huge cream feather vane with a dark spine. It is held in the RIGHT hand at mid-shaft, feather upright at rest. In the LEFT hand he carries a thick open book with an oxblood-leather cover, brass corners and glowing gold pages. His magic and trails are GOLDEN INK and drifting illuminated pages: amber-gold swirls with white-hot highlights; the charged orb is a sphere of golden ink-light with pages spiralling inside.

ART STYLE: Premium, high-detail anime 2D fighting-game sprite art: the look of a carefully hand-pixelled character sprite rendered at high resolution - crisp deliberate dark outlines (not thick black cartoon lines), cel shading with three to four tones per material, bright specular highlights on metal, a cool rim light, an expressive face with a clear eye, anatomically correct hands with readable fingers, convincing anime anatomy, fluid hair and cloth that follow the motion. Exactly the rendering, palette and level of detail of the attached reference sheet. Not vector art, not blurry, not chibi, no photorealism.

SHEET CONTENT (transparent background, image 1536x1024, no text, no labels, no grid lines, every figure separate):
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right with the quill staff held upright in the right hand and the open book in the left; a combat stance with the staff raised; a walking pose with the waistcoat swinging; a running pose; a jump with the curls flying; a close-up of the quill feather crown
- middle rows: six casting poses: golden ink bolts launched from the nib, a two-handed overhead swing releasing a golden crescent of ink, a charged golden orb of ink-light held at the staff head, a downward plunge with the nib driven toward the ground, an aerial sweep scattering golden pages
- bottom row: guard with the staff across the body and the book raised, a hit reaction, knocked down, a victory pose with the open book held high, the Rewritten Fate pose with golden pages swirling around him
Every figure faces RIGHT (three-quarter side view like the house style), the same scale (standing height about 240 px), feet on
the same ground line within each row.
